idea-plugin.name: ExtendedHighlighting
idea-plugin.description:
Adds syntax highlighting for C# operators that Rider does not support by default. These are treated as symbols without any real semantics i.e. it will override all uses of the symbol so overriding ! will apply to all. All highlightings default to the colour for operators from the user's current settings, but they can be individually set. The list of configurable symbols includes:
  • ?
  • ??
  • ??=
  • :
  • !
  • =>
